summary: Flight Recorder direction: a calm ruled dossier where prose reads and evidence certifies, with docked tool rows, session-scoped evidence bench, attestation motion, affidavit typography, and the cite-back rule as signature.

claims.claim: Direction commits to a single dossier/attestation thesis and every field traces back to it
Cite-back rule signature is defined with recurrence locations and frequency regulation
System potential covers other surfaces, all stub states, long/short content, and 375-1440px viewports
Candidate diverges on five structural axes, not palette, from category default and sibling lenses
Evidence plan names judgeable specimens at real density including non-happy states and responsive behavior

decisions.choice: Commit Run candidate direction-flight-recorder to the dossier/attestation thesis: every agent claim is entered into a calm, ruled dossier where prose reads and evidence certifies, with the cite-back rule as signature
rationale: Territory 1 assignment binds this lens; committing fully preserves slate divergence
Brief trust pressure (verify every consequential step) is answered structurally by docking evidence under claims, not by styling
Attestation motion and ledger surfaces are the only coherent expression of a recorder thesis; softening either breaks traceability
alternatives: Soften thesis toward generic calm chat with trace as accessory
Adopt control-room density or reading-room withdrawal to ease layout work
risks: Archival or slow reading if rules feel bureaucratic
Failure urgency diluted on a quiet ground
revisitWhen: Blind critique finds the ledger reads archival or failures lack urgency
Surface architecture proves docked rows cannot survive 375px without crushing the reading column

risks: Archival or slow reading if ruled paper plus restrained motion feels bureaucratic rather than capable
Tool failures may lack urgency on a quiet ground without glow or toast theater
Dense tabular wings may leak noise into the calm reading column if rule weights slip
Ledger monotony across 50-plus turns unless turn order and cite-back references stay scannable
Long stub runs may feel frozen without shimmer unless skeleton-to-row staging is clearly progressive
